args: if (-not (Get-Command npm.cmd -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $nodeDirectory = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'nodejs'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $nodeDirectory 'npm.cmd')) { $env:Path = $nodeDirectory + ';' + $env:Path } }; $npmCommand = Get-Command npm.cmd -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($npmCommand) { Set-Alias -Name npm -Value $npmCommand.Source }
